title: Customer Controls Concierge: Weighted decision canvas for log redaction, retention, and PII export locking
creator: Ava Morgan
description: Create a customer-facing 'Controls Concierge' decision canvas and internal scorecard used by PMs and Solutions Engineering to consistently intake, prioritize, and route non-bug customer requests for log redaction, log retention adjustments, PII handling, and audit exports. Outcome: reduce time-to-response, align cross-functional reviewers, and lower escalation churn for enterprise customers with compliance needs.
background: We receive varied enterprise requests that touch logging, PII, and exports: from short-term retention holds and targeted redaction to full dataset exports for audits. Current triage is ad-hoc across support, SE, and PM which leads to inconsistent SLAs and repeated clarification cycles. Legal and Security review requirements vary by request and region, causing delays. This initiative codifies a lightweight intake + scoring model and a set of routing templates (legal/security/compliance/engineering) to accelerate decisions and standardize responses.
triage_workflow_summary: 1) Customer completes Controls Concierge intake form. 2) Auto-score computes urgency/risk/engineering-cost. 3) PM/SE reviews with suggested route (Legal, Security, Engineering, Dedicated Ops). 4) Trigger templates: response SLO, required artifacts, decision owner. 5) If high risk or PII export > threshold, auto-escalate to Security + Legal for review and approval checklist.
intake_form_fields: Type of request: redaction | retention | PII export | audit export
Scope: specific logs / tenant / date range / tokens affected
Attachments: legal notice, court order, audit checklist, PSP (if any)
Region(s) impacted and data residency constraints
priority_scorecard: Technical effort (in dev-days) inverted to score (0-5)
Risk to platform or security posture (0-5)
Likelihood of repeat request / operational burden (0-5)
Total score interpretation: 18-30 = P0 escalate; 11-17 = P1 route; 0-10 = P2 handle in standard backlog
decision_routing_matrix: Score >= 18 & involves PII export -> Route: Legal + Security + Eng, SLA: 72 hours
Score >= 18 & retention or redaction impacting production -> Route: Eng + Dedicated Ops, SLA: 48 hours
11-17 & no legal mandate -> Route: PM + SE, provide templated response and estimated timeline
<=10 & low impact -> Route to backlog with standard acknowledgement and guidance
Any request citing court order or subpoena -> Immediate Legal intake & freeze on deletion until clearance
acceptance_criteria: Concierge intake form published in Support and SE playbooks
Automated score calculation implemented as a Google Sheet + Zapier prototype OR Redwood Console rule
Three routing templates (Legal, Security, Engineering) documented with required artifacts and SLOs
Runbook for handling PII exports including minimum review checklist and encryption/transfer guidelines
Metrics dashboard: time-to-first-response, time-to-resolution, fraction escalated to Legal
Hands-on training session delivered to Support and SEs with example scenarios
